inverse: Exclude overlapping matched edges, nonexact coverage, closure implication violations, wrong cycle/entry/distance, or nonminimum arborescence cost. None means infeasible, not cost zero; a returned arborescence edge witness is outside the API.

Arborescence cost c admits all rooted graphs with optimum c; selected edges are unrecoverable. Matching/cover/closure witnesses admit different unused edges/rows/weights. Cycle/entry/distance summaries admit distinct successor forests between adjacent distance layers.
limitations: Successful allocations and each leaf's finite domain/error precedence. These are tagged relations, not automatic production adoption. Floating residuals are not solution-error guarantees. No generic 1/2/5/10% composition-wide profile; finite evidence remains separate from analytical claims.
Finite observations and partial syntax do not establish universal proof.
